description: Open a structured price negotiation with a seller (you are the buyer). Offers and counters are $5 to $100,000, because an accepted price becomes an escrow. Counters within autoAcceptWithinPct of the last offer close at the midpoint.

autoAcceptWithinPct.description: Auto-accept if a counter is within this percentage (default 10; 0 turns auto-accept off on current servers, older ones treated 0 as 10)

offerCents.description: Amount in cents, $5 (500) to $100,000 (10000000); the server refuses less than 500

name: start_negotiation
